purpose: Name the RAM gate that controls one-shot entry and Z80 retry behavior for the frame input/resource service.

consumer.name: Frame_InputAndResourceService
consumer.entry_test: 0x001A91DA returns without servicing when the gate is nonzero.
consumer.set_before_service: 0x001A91F0 sets the gate before the VDP palette snapshot and service sequence.
consumer.completion_set: 0x001A92C6 leaves the gate set after the palette upload and before the completion marker.

retry.condition: Z80 status bit 5 requests another input/resource service iteration.
retry.action: Clears the gate and branches back to the VBlank wait/service loop.

evidence: Startup clear, pre-service set, completion set, and Z80 retry clear
No independent producer or consumer is assigned beyond this service lifecycle
conclusion: FFF168 is the Frame_InputAndResourceService one-shot/retry gate. It is distinct from FRAME_WAIT_LATCH and VBLANK_READY_LATCH: those control waiting and optional Z80 handshake behavior, while this byte controls re-entry into the higher-level input/resource service body.
